decisions.reason: The source specifies the pace and continuous cadence of Airbnb host outreach; it does not change the general initiative, fallback, reporting, or review workflow.
The source does not address where task artifacts must be stored or which links and documents must accompany them.
The source does not change how completed subtasks or goal parent tasks are marked in ClickUp.
The impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY updating outreach pace and cadence; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Although the content bank remains in the source Requirement's assignment set, the source message changes only Airbnb outreach pace and cadence.
The source governs initial copy-and-paste outreach, not how interested hosts are advanced, scheduled, or coordinated after replying.
The source does not alter Shopify publication, product coverage, categorization, batch size, or listing deadlines.
The source does not change CJ Dropshipping product selection criteria, quantities, outputs, or deadlines.
Sending outreach messages continuously does not change which interested hosts are recorded or when they are entered into HubSpot.
The source concerns Airbnb host messaging and does not change TikTok Shop product-listing behavior.
The source does not address completion, visibility, or storage of the CRM structure document.
The source does not change the timing or structure of cross-channel product listing records.
